d.ko: Lead the Mobile Infantry in this RTS game set in the Starship Troopers film universe. Balance your army composition with a diverse set of unit types, overcome line-of-sight and line-of-fire challenges through tactical positioning, and use special abilities to smash the Arachnid hordes!
d.en: Lead the Mobile Infantry in this RTS game set in the Starship Troopers film universe. Balance your army composition with a diverse set of unit types, overcome line-of-sight and line-of-fire challenges through tactical positioning, and use special abilities to smash the Arachnid hordes!
d.zh: 在这款以《星河战队》电影宇宙为背景的即时战略游戏中，带领机动步兵团冲锋陷阵。通过分队类型的多样化组合来平衡你的部队组成，借助战术选位来克服视线与弹道挑战，以及利用丰富的特殊技能来击溃阿拉奇虫
